entities.summary: GitMind is a web-based mind mapping and diagramming application developed by WANGXU TECHNOLOGY (HK) CO., LIMITED, launched in 2019. GitMind supports the creation of visual diagrams such as mind maps, flowcharts, UML diagrams, organizational charts, Ishikawa diagrams, and entity–relationship diagrams.
